frontmatter.name: api-contract-check
frontmatter.description: Verify src/routes/api/v1 routes follow this repo's API conventions — apiError() usage, error codes documented in README, and openapi.ts/well-known specs in sync. Use after adding or changing any /api/v1 route, or before a release touching the API.

frontmatter.name: create-migration
frontmatter.description: Scaffold a new Supabase migration file in supabase/migrations/, following this repo's naming convention and its SECURITY DEFINER RPC pattern for atomic writes under RLS. Use when the user asks to add/change a table, column, RPC function, or RLS policy.

frontmatter.name: finish-feature
frontmatter.description: Finish a git-flow-next feature/bugfix branch in this repo - runs the correctness gates, drafts a summary of what changed from the branch's commits, then merges it back into develop with a signed commit. Use when the user asks to finish/wrap up/merge a feature or bugfix branch, or says a feature is done and ready to merge.

frontmatter.name: ui-consistency-check
frontmatter.description: Check a new or changed Svelte component/page against this repo's existing design tokens, layout components, and shared UI primitives (Button, Dialog family, EmptyState, ErrorState, Toast, etc.) for consistency. Use after writing or editing anything under src/lib/components, src/lib/layout, or src/routes/**/*.svelte.
